subject: ACME POC kickoff recap - scope, metrics, owners, timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jared Ellis <jared.ellis@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME POC kickoff recap - scope, metrics, owners, timeline

Thanks again for the call this morning 0 great to meet the ACME team. Per our discussion, below is a concise recap and confirmed next steps so everyone is aligned ahead of the kickoff next week. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of pain points (what ACME shared):
- Support engineers spending ~30% of time triaging customer tickets with high-volume, repetitive diagnostics.
- Current retrieval and search pipeline returns noisy results; agents spend time filtering false positives.
- Need to control costs and maintain sub-200ms latency for query surfaces that are customer-facing.

POC goal (what success looks like):
- Reduce avg time-to-resolution for tier-1 tickets by 20% (measured via time-to-first-action on a labeled prompt set).
- Maintain <200ms median generation latency for the primary support search path.
- Achieve precision �03 0.75 on the curated prompt/eval set for suggested diagnostics.

Scope / deliverables for 6-week POC:
1) Baseline data ingest: sample/support-ticket export (anonymized) + vector index for retrieval (ACME deliverable).
2) Redwood deliverable: model selection and config (2 model variants), prompt suite (initial 40 prompts), and eval harness with pass/fail thresholds.
3) Integration: a test endpoint + simple UI for internal evaluation (no production routing).
4) Metrics and weekly checkpoints: success metrics dashboard + weekly demo.

Owners and roles:
- ACME: Jared Ellis (Product), Priya Shah (Support lead), Tom Weller (Procurement for contract paperwork).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, POC owner), Aditya Rao (Infra/setup), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineer - prompts & evals).

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW and share REDACTed sample ticket export; IRM/access checklist.
- Week 1: infra access (API keys, VPN if needed), initial data ingest, index build.
- Week 2: first model + prompt pass, internal smoke tests.
- Weeks 3-4: iterative tuning, metric tracking, weekly demos.
- Week 5-6: final evaluation against success criteria, final report and next steps.

Access/setup items we need from ACME (action items):
- Shared S3 export or secure link to anonymized tickets (s3://acme-support-sample or Drive link).
- A scoped test account or api key for your staging system (read-only) + allowlist IPs (we provided IP ranges in the checklist).
- Point of contact for procurement so we can finalize the SOW and issue the kickoff PO.

Attachments: acme-poc-sow-draft.pdf (attached), redwood-access-checklist.md (attached), poc-success-metrics.xlsx (attached).

Next steps:
- Marissa to send final SOW by EOD Friday.
- ACME to share anonymized sample data and procurement contact.
- Schedule kickoff meeting (proposed: Tue 6/8 10am PT).

Thanks again 0 looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Marissa 0 this looks right to me and aligns with our notes. A few clarifications and updates: 
- Procurement: looping in Tom to handle SOW/PO. Tom 0 can you confirm typical lead times for a small POC PO?
- Data: we can provide a 7k-ticket anonymized export (CSV + JSON attachments) to a secure S3 bucket by EOD Monday. Will mark the dataset as redacted per our compliance policy.

One ask on metrics: can Redwood include per-prompt precision/recall breakdowns in the weekly dashboard? That will help our team prioritize prompts to iterate on.
